goal: Deliver and publish one verified VII release that completes all ten approved visual, interaction, recovery, performance, copy and localization chapters without regressing booking or data truth.

intent_model.literal_request: Perform all ten items as one complete project with simulated Adir, then report only after testing.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A visibly finished, fast and coherent public site whose shared families work, not ten isolated code edits.
likely_rejections: One screenshot fixed while the family remains inconsistent
A local build reported without public proof
Performance gained by removing content or changing truth

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: All ten chapters require an explicit family inventory, shared implementation, tests and one release.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No chapter can remain pending and no representative sample substitutes for family coverage.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: One clear task and primary action per visible state.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: The visitor chooses a place, date, map or recovery path without competing controls.
cognitive_flow.next_action: The selected route or action acknowledges immediately and reaches a useful result.
deferred_complexity: Live supplier confirmation until dates or booking

facts.claim: Sites version 533 is the current verified public baseline.
The full product audit identifies remaining shared visual, recovery, payload and localization work.

assumptions.claim: The existing Sites project remains the authorized public target.
assumptions.validation: Re-read project/version/deployment before saving the release.

in_scope: Unify and repair all relevant horizontal rails
Make shared cards whole-card links while isolating phone and WhatsApp
Repair nearby and deferred map recovery
Remove redundant technical copy and handle illustrative media truthfully
Complete loading, empty, error, retry and back states
Apply safe critical-render and media-loading improvements
Repair contact, contextless booking and 404 recovery
Repair first-viewport language and Hebrew typography
Build, test, publish and independently verify one exact candidate
out_of_scope: Live RBAC proof requiring unavailable accounts
invariants: No-date online capability remains last-known-good and fast
Catalog counts, ranking and filters remain truthful
Phone and WhatsApp remain independent actions
Illustrative media is never presented as a real business

requirements.statement: Vacation room cards are compact, information-rich, sharp and balanced on desktop and mobile.
Spa, event, provider, vacation and hourly rails start correctly in RTL and never expose clipped cards, native scrollbars or distorted media.
Every shared result card is one accessible activation target except phone and WhatsApp, which stay independent.
Nearby and map flows always leave loading and provide a useful manual recovery path while preserving search state.
Public copy contains no redundant technical filler, and illustration disclosure remains truthful.
requirements.source: Approved chapter 5 and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: Every affected asynchronous surface has stable loading, empty, error, retry, reload and back behavior.
Safe performance improvements reduce critical work and layout shift without changing catalog truth or booking semantics.
Contact, contextless booking and 404 routes provide useful canonical recovery instead of a dead end or duplicate purpose.
HE/EN/FR/RU first viewports use the correct language, direction and modern Hebrew typography without a mixed-language flash.
One immutable candidate is fully tested, reviewed by simulated Adir, published through the established task and verified publicly with rollback.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative vacation place with multiple room configurations
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect full room section at 1440px, 390px and after reload
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No giant white area, missing facts, image distortion or displaced action; all existing room data remains reachable.

acceptance_checks.setup: First, middle and last positions of each rail
acceptance_checks.action: Open and operate with pointer, touch and keyboard
acceptance_checks.observable_result: RTL start, exact snap, correct arrows, no native scrollbar, no clipped edge and stable image ratio.

acceptance_checks.action: Activate body, phone and WhatsApp separately
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Body opens detail; phone and WhatsApp perform only their own actions and do not bubble into detail.

acceptance_checks.setup: Location denied, unavailable or timed out
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Loading ends promptly, manual location is offered and prior dates, guests and filters remain.

acceptance_checks.action: Scan settled copy and media captions
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No supplier-internal filler or duplicate explanation; verified real media has no illustration label and illustrative media remains clearly disclosed.

acceptance_checks.setup: Slow or failed affected API and failed image decode
acceptance_checks.action: Wait, retry, reload and navigate back
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Final geometry remains stable, last-known-good remains where allowed, errors are actionable and retry restores the surface.

acceptance_checks.setup: Cold public home and search requests
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Critical content appears without blank flash, secondary work is deferred, images reserve space, and counts/ranking/final results remain unchanged.

acceptance_checks.setup: Open contact, booking without required context and an unknown route
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Contact has one real purpose, booking returns to a useful search or place path, and 404 has a dedicated title and usable search.

acceptance_checks.setup: Cold and warm HE/EN/FR/RU representative routes
acceptance_checks.action: Observe first paint and settled view at desktop and 390px
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Correct language/direction is visible from first paint, with no Hebrew leftovers on LTR routes and no forbidden Hebrew font fallback.

acceptance_checks.setup: Exact candidate and pinned version 533 baseline
acceptance_checks.action: Run full tests, publish once and inspect exact deployed version
acceptance_checks.observable_result: All required checks pass publicly, deployment identity is recorded and version 533 remains recoverable.

acceptance_checks.setup: Selected filters, dates and last-known-good online capability
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Valid state persists, stale transient failure does not erase eligible cached discovery, and no duplicate action occurs.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, verification and one public Sites release are authorized. Primary DNS, real transactions, messaging, destructive data changes and certifications are not.
